objective: Make Hina text chat start against the real loopback Ollama provider by bootstrapping the configured server, checking the configured qwen3.5:4b model, and returning actionable diagnostics instead of a generic unavailable stream error.
non_goals: Do not add fake or canned chat replies.
Do not expose the model server beyond numeric loopback.
Do not execute model-generated code or tools.
Do not run deep repeat or soak verification in this fast iteration.
contracts: The configured provider remains loopback-only and no renderer gains raw network access.
Desktop and Dev Console startup start Ollama only when the configured provider is unavailable.
Startup verifies the configured model exists before reporting model readiness.
No fake response is returned when installation, startup or model availability fails.
allowed_dependencies: Ollama local runtime and the existing qwen3.5:4b model configuration.
acceptance_criteria: A startup helper discovers Ollama from PATH or its standard Windows install path and starts it hidden when required.
The helper verifies qwen3.5:4b through the loopback Ollama API and emits an actionable error when it is absent.
A real Ollama chat request completes against qwen3.5:4b.
Existing text-brain unit tests remain green.
